inputs.name: interior leather layers at the spine

scenarios.label: cards and other contents only (no interior leather)

failure_modes.name: Grain crack at the hinge
failure_modes.text: spine: tension-face strain 8.7 % loose to 9.0 % taut (closed-form limit 8.4 %), inside radius 5.43 mm, R/t = 5.4; within the screening rules. Cycles to crack need flex-test data.

failure_modes.name: Permanent set
failure_modes.text: needs a cyclic viscoplastic model and fold-and-measure data; it is the usual first visible sign of a worn hinge

failure_modes.name: Finish crazing or delamination
failure_modes.text: a film-on-substrate model quoted in prior-research/reference/durability.md section 2b has a stiff finish buckling at 2-12 % compressive strain; the compression face of the spine is -8.2 % but the grain is in tension, not compression

failure_modes.name: Stress at stitch holes
failure_modes.text: the perimeter stitch line crosses the spine fold (spine); a row of holes across a bend removes most of the section there. No local model yet

failure_modes.name: Skive-line or thickness step
failure_modes.text: the record says the spine is not skived; interior pieces step in height away from the fold, not across it

failure_modes.name: Edge paint chipping
failure_modes.text: the edge treatment is not recorded; record it (painted edges chip where they flex)

failure_modes.name: Pocket-mouth and corner abrasion
failure_modes.text: 2 pocket(s) recorded; needs the card-pull scenario (roadmap phase 4) and wear photos to calibrate

failure_modes.name: Perforation tear line
failure_modes.text: 140 stitch holes in a line that crosses the fold

failure_modes.name: Layer delamination
failure_modes.text: layers are treated as perfectly bonded; the record does not say what is glued

failure_modes.name: Cold embrittlement
failure_modes.text: needs a cold flex test; no built-in factor

failure_modes.name: Over-drying
failure_modes.text: needs a measured material state (stiffness and strain to crack at a stated humidity)

failure_modes.name: Long-term chemical ageing
failure_modes.text: ageing enters only through measured aged states; none recorded
